recs.name: Incoming Mail
recs.tag: Don't worry too much about Laterano people, they can cope fine no matter where they end up.

lines.x: Pop! Pop! Pop!
Bangbang! Pop!
Dadadada! Ba-bang!
Pewpewpew! Bangbang!
One enemy left, exactly one rubber bullet left. No waste, no pollution, all emergency conserved, it's great for the environment. Whaddya think?
What a persistent fella, chasing me down three blocks and whatnot. I already told you, I don't have the goods.
You bitch! What are you going on about the environment for? You tryna mess with me?!
Took you that long to figure out? What else was I to do? Taking out the lot of you would've been super boring.
Anyway, I guess that's game over. So like, would you care to say any last words? Speak now or forever hold your peace~
Stay back! Get away from me!
Bang! You're dead!
Guh... Urgh...
—Bullseye!
Look at that impeccable aim. Good job, me! Heh, guess I'll treat myself to an extra slice of apple pie today!
Next up... back to work!
Hmm, today's last address, Center Street No. 12-7, Ah Choi Restaurant...
Woah, I'm sorry, did I just bump into you?
Don't worry about it.
Ah Choi Restaurant is that way. Totally opposite direction.
Ah, you're right... Thanks a bunch, mister.
Don't mention it. It's not every day I meet a fellow countryman.
...Huh?
(A Laterano? A Messenger, by the looks of things...)
(Messages, huh...)
(It'd probably be a good idea to write home before Sauin.)
We should have some stationery back at the base... Hm, guess I should pick up some souvenirs to send over with the letter.
Oh, gotta finish work first... Now where is it, Ah Choi Restaurant...
All right, here it is.
Excuse me. Anyone? Penguin Logistics home delivery—
Who is it...? Woah! What happened here? What's that on the ground... is he d-dead?!
Hehe, it's no big deal. Don't freak out over every little corpse!
Penguin Logistics is offering a special smashed, bloody street sale! Act fast within the next three days and get our deliveries half off! Anyway, these are the goods you ordered, right?
Express delivery?
Wait, I don't think this is right.
Eh?
I did order something, but it's only been a few hours since I placed the order. There's no way it could've come this fast...
And that's where you're wrong. You said it's been a few hours, so getting it now sounds just about right?
After all, speed is the lifeblood of the logistics industry!
Amplifiers, lanterns, and flower baskets. Woah, are you opening a new store?
Um, yeah...
Wow, good luck! Anyway, all your stuff's right here. What's the matter, something wrong?
I must say, this is exactly what I ordered...
Are you for real?
Real as the wings on my back. Intracity deliveries are a piece of cake. Would've gotten here even faster if not for those troublesome fellas lying over there on the road...
Huh?
All righty, don't worry about it, okay? If you're good to go, please sign right here!
Oh... Here, and here...
Very good. That's another job well done!
Bye bye then! Remember to leave me a good review!
Hey, hold on...
Ungh... ugh...
Good grief... Girls these days...
At least clean up the 'trash' you brought with you before you leave...
Aaaand, that finishes up the last item!
With that, another day of work comes to a close.
Yo–– Texas, Croissant, the two of you done with work yet?
No issues here. Everything got delivered.
Got mah hands on the Baws's thing over on my end!
Some fellers tried to swipe the stuff, but I took care of 'em real good. What's so interestin' about an ol' box anyway? Ain't got a clue as to what's inside...
Maybe it's something dangerous. Either way, it's our responsibility to get rid of anyone trying to drag us down, no matter what.
Anyway, that's that. Time to head home!
Stop... right there...
Hm?
Exusiai, you were in charge over here, right? Why's this guy still able to talk?
You can't use live rounds in residential areas.
These guys don't exactly look like gangsters either. If I don't follow the rules, things'll get pretty messy for us.
Besides, we're here to help rebuild the neighborhood and we were told not to cause any trouble. I made specially sure to avoid any vitals.
I suppose so.
Give them a lifeline, and the people here should be able to seize the opportunity and pull themselves out. Should be fine.
The last time Exusiai was able to use live rounds was when she was pickin' up that Rhodes Islander, right?
Them was some wild days! Baws sure does seem sweet on that thar Rhodes Island. I reckon we got a long 'n fruitful relationship ahead of us.
Sounds about right. They've got some pretty interesting folks over there, so it's no surprise the Boss has taken a liking to them.
Enough to cause trouble.
Hehe, isn't that the Boss's favorite?
You'n say that again!
But gettin' sent overseas to work sure sounds like a pain in the tail.
That's pretty much the same thing we do, isn't it? Just with some extra mileage.
The salary and overtime pay there are pretty darn good too. Throw on whatever the Boss gives us over here, and it's like having twice the moolah!
No foolin'? double?! Looks like this li'l lady's about to be laughin all the way to the bank!
I wanna go, too! Exusiai, bring me along next time!
Haha, I knew that's what you'd say.
Ah, crap, how'd it get this late already?
C'mon, Texas, pick up the pace. We gotta hurry back to base before it's too late!
Get in the car. Hang on tight.
Waaaaait, hold on a sec! Okay, I'm ready! Step on it!
Where's the fire, anyway? Hey, Texas, ain't you gonna ask why she's in such a hurry?
There's no way it's anything that matters.
Huh, good point.
Hey, don't talk about me like I'm not here! And I'll have you know, it's super important!
If we don't get back soon, the apple pie I put in the oven's gonna burn!
How in tarnation is that important? Woooooooahh! Texas, how fast you cornerin'——?
Too slow!
I had time to enjoy three LPs, both sides. Is it your legs, or your brain? How'd a couple of simple deliveries take that long?
Phew, thank goodness, the apple pie is safe!
Mmmmh, that's the aroma I could die for! The heat's just right too, absolutely perfect!
Yo! Listen to me when I'm talkin' to you!
Baws, we was floorin' it to get back here.
Lucky fer us, we didn't bump into any cops. Last thing you want's a ticket poppin' up on the doormat. That'd be a month of Texas's take-home down the drain.
In other words! Texas put her own salary on the line to rush back over here, so don't blame her, Boss.
Texas, what'cha got?
You gonna let the girls leave you their messes to clean up like that?
Sigh...
It's whatever.
Ugh. Lame.
Because I'm so magnanimous, I won't make a fuss over y'all being slower than a bad dump. Now, where's my stuff?
Right here.
Now we're talkin'! Yo Exu, I need my chair and those fancy electric specs!
Coming right up, Boss!
What'd you get this time? Huh... This box is pretty heavy. Some kind of machinery?
Oh! I think that logo and the controller shape's givin' me a clue...
That's gotta be the thingy majigger what's all sold outta the markets... some last-generation vidja games console? I heard some rich folks have been buyin' 'em up, top dollar.
Heh, games. Who's to say that life ain't just one big game?
Texas, hook it up.
This line here?
Woah, we got a picture!
Hrmm, oh? Looks like a side-scrolling racing game... direction keys, accelerator...
And then, what's this button here? Is this supposed to be a bomb?
T'ain't no bomb. Looks a bit more like...
An Originium rocket launcher.
I knew it!
Wait a minute, ain't this one of them games, the kind where you dodge obstacles and whatnot 'til you get to the end? Why'd they put in a Originium rocket launcher...?
You damned fool! Like hiding and dodging is the only way to reach the end?
I get it now, you can just charge forward in a straight line and send anything in your way packing! Now that's the kind of game I like, nice and simple rules.
Looks like the controls are working just fine. And I think it's even got a two-player mode!
Say, Boss, wanna give it a shot?
You challengin' me to a match? What's the fun in playin' a game you know you'll win?
Texas, you're up.
Sigh...
I know.
Great, I got full ammo. Watch this!
You went and blew up all them buildings in yer way. Sounds about right fer you, actually...
Hahaha! What's wrong with taking down a building or two? I'm gonna win this round for sure!
...You're wide open!
(Fires an explosive at the opposite lane)
Whoa!
They let'cha shoot at the other player's lane?!
Nobody said you can't.
Indeed, nobody said you can't. But if you're gonna pull that trick on me, don't blame me for what happens next...
As they say, an eye for an eye! What goes around, comes around! Dodge this if you can, I'm gonna blow you away!
Wh-What the heck, you'n just go and shoot the other car too?!
Nobody said you can't, right? Hehe, I'm going for the gold, baby!
Hm? Somebody at the door.
Good afternoon, everyone.
What are you playing? All the yelling and screaming spooked me at the door.
Well, if it ain't Sora! C'mon in, take a seat. Exusiai and Texas're playin' vidja games. Baws got his flippers on an old game console, and he's lettin' us have first go at it.
Wanna play?
Video games? I think I'll pass, I'm no good at those.
Oh, by the way, I grabbed the mail on my way in. Are you sure you can keep this up? There's a whole mountain of bills this month...
And one more thing... here, there's something for you, Exusiai.
Mail, for me? Wonder if it's a bill, or a challenge.
Ehh, I'm sure it's not the diploma that the school was supposed to reissue, right...?
Whassat? You never got yer graduation diploma?
Of course I got it!
It's just, uh, the last time I got in a fight with the gang, I accidentally burnt it all along with the fake bank notes and the fake diploma the Boss made us.
I even reminded you.
Did you now? Sorry, I don't seem to remember that at all!
That does sound like something you'd do.
But this letter looks like a pretty ordinary, personal letter. It probably isn't any of the things you just listed off...
Hard to say.
Hey, Croissant, here's the controller. Take my spot for a bit.
Can do!
Hmm, let's take a look.
...Huh, it's from my sister..
Now that I think about it, I did run into a Laterano Messenger earlier today.
Woah, if she wrote this whole thick stack of stuff, she must really be worried sick...
Exusiai's sister?
Wait, hold on a second, why do I seem to recall that your sister was in some kind of accident...? Isn't that why you came all the way to Lungmen looking for Mostima?
Hm? That sounds right to me.
My sister was in an accident a number of years back, and ended up in a deep coma, in the hospital for a long time...
Then...
But, she had already woken up by the time I left Laterano!
Huh? What's wrong, Sora? Why do you look like you just saw the Boss gyrating while singing some sappy love song?
Huh?!
Where'd you get that overly specific example from anyway? My eyes already hurt just thinking about it!
Uhh... nothing, don't mind me. It's just, I sometimes feel stupid for genuinely worrying about you...
Ah, lemme guess... You didn't happen to misunderstand something before, did you?
Uh...
Huh, really? You serious?
Though my sister did have some pretty severe injuries, she's been gradually recovering. Otherwise, how could I just ditch her and run around the world?!
You do have a point.
Right?
Well, I can't blame you for misunderstanding. After all, things did look pretty dicey back then.
And I thought someone like her never could've gotten hurt like that. But there she was, her bloodied, unconscious body...
B-Bloody?!
Yeah, things got way crazier that time than what we normally get into.
I always thought I was a pretty brave girl, but I clearly remember being scared into a cold sweat. Just thinking about it now still makes my hands shake.
Not even kidding. At the time, I hadn't sorted things through in my head, and I nearly jumped into a fight with the one who brought my sister back.
I can imagine...
But, that person you just mentioned... was that Mostima?
Bingo, the very same. After bringing my sister back, she immediately disappeared to Lord-knows-where.
Even after my sister regained consciousness, she wouldn't tell me what happened...
How could I go on without knowing the whole story?
So basically, I just wanted to find out what happened. I chased Mostima all the way from Laterano to Lungmen, and that's when I met the Boss.
Um, how do I put it... So it's like...
That whole thing with you joining up, plus the fact that you always try to cut the conversation short every time Mostima's name comes up, I just assumed you had some bad blood with her.
If we're talking about how Mostima always dragged my sister into working overtime, and how many times that ended with me getting stood up, then yeah, we do have some bad blood.
Huh? You knew each other as kids?
Hmm... Darn it, I can't paint a mental picture of your sister at all.
Just the thought of there being another person like you is already giving me a headache.
Haha, don't you worry about that. She and I are very different.
Really?
Yeah. After all, we don't share any blood.
Hwuh?!
No foolin'?!
Of course... Wait, Croissant, how come you're listening in?
You ain't never talked about yer past. I'm so curious I just can't help mahself...
I don't talk about my past?
Oh, let's save the story for later! Don't get distracted. Just keep gaming!
—Too late.
I win.
Ahhhh! Texas! That's darn underhanded to pass me up like that!!
Ugh... Total defeat.
(Everyone sure is curious.)
(But, did I really never bring up the thing with my sister before?)
(Well, I guess it's not altogether surprising, since nobody bothered asking...)
(Speaking of Mostima, I've been waiting for eons now and she still hasn't shown up. Is the Boss trying to pull a fast one on me?)
(Whatever, I'll just have to go with the flow! First, gotta write a response though...)
Hm, wonder if we have any snacks that won't go bad or break...
Oh, Exusiai, where are you going? Not going to play anymore?
Right, you guys have fun. I'm going to go shopping for some nice gifts. Be right back~
We'll have a rematch later tonight, Texas! That round just now didn't count, so let's have a redo!
Hehe, just you wait! I'm gonna win for sure!

recs.name: Constants Within Changes
recs.tag: Live in the present and enjoy it.

lines.x: I'm curious now. Where did you run off to in the time it took me to use the toilet?
Would you believe me if I told you my life was at risk?
I was under the impression that Lungmen was a city of law and order.
I'm just as curious as you are as to why random pedestrians would be after my head in such a well-policed city.
Okay, I might actually have a pretty good idea of why.
Go find a milk tea place, and get me a cup. See ya.
Hey, what the hell's up with your––
Texas, you could say we're coworkers, right?
More or less.
I don't think coworkers are supposed to draw swords on each other.
But Exusiai's been looking for you this whole time.
And you're a slippery one, so I figured it'd be easier to hogtie you and haul you over to her.
Oh, Siracusans. You always get the job done clean.
I have to admit, though, I was this close to letting you do it.
But at this point, you can't catch me anymore.
Emperor talked to me about you. I never planned to take you on alone.

Hey, Texas, aren't you on delivery? Why do you need me all of a...
Huh?!
Hi there.
Mostima?!
Just happened to bump into her.
Good going, Texas!
Same plan as always. I'm up front, you wrap around.
Tie her to a chair. I've got all sorts of ways to make her spill what you're looking for.
Siracusan ways?
Texas ways.
El, you're not really going to fight me, are you?
Why not?
The boss talks a lot about business culture. Even though his slogans change every day, I've always held onto one for myself––
Play hard!
So let's play, Mostima.
Alright, we'll play a little game of cops and robbers. If you can catch me, you win.
Does it matter how I do it?
You can even smack me around, El. Use your gun if you'd like.
Huh?
Don't worry, the commandments don't protect fallen angels.

Ooh...
Wait, I can't use guns downtown! And you don't get to use your Arts!
Okay, let's dial up the difficulty a bit. You––
I won't use my Arts.
But you're still going to use your swords, right?
As long as you don't resist too much, you probably won't get hurt.
Alrighty. Three–– (Winks)
(Nods slightly)
Start!
She's fast!
I know all your little tricks, El.
Of course you do...
Texas, have you eaten?
Yes. How about you?
I'll manage.
Then let’s get going.
Alrighty!
Ya seem mighty busy today, Exusiai.
Eh, I'm okay, Croissant. You're setting a stall up over here?
Sure am. Didn't have much work today, so I figured I'd do a little hawkin'.
Oh right, have you seen a blue-haired angel? I think I saw her linger here for a little while, from off in the distance.
If'n you mean that Mostima of yers, she went that-a-way.
Alrighty, thanks a bunch.
That about satisfy ya?
And here I was thinking you'd double-cross me halfway through.
Y'all playin' some kinda game?
How'd you know?
Well, I reckon since you've been duckin' her this long, if'n you didn't want her to find you, Exusiai'd never see heads or tails of ya.
Then why didn't you help her?
Let's just say you've piqued my curiosity.
'Course, since I helped ya, ya gotta show my enterprise here a li'l love.
Then, I'll have a smoked sausage.
Now yer talkin'.
What do you want to get out of me?
Hmm... It's less gettin' somethin' outta ya, and more somethin' I wanted to tell ya.
Since she came here lookin' for ya, n' all the time she spent waitin' for ya, Exusiai's been in Lungmen for a good number of years now.
But I'n see that her search ain't no grave matter o' life n' death. Just look at what a whallopin' good time she's havin' in Lungmen!
She talks you up as some kinda unbelievably powerful being, carryin' a buncha secrets you can't tell nobody, haulin' a big pile of yer own problems on them shoulders fer good measure.
But it's been an awful long time. Ya do kinda owe her an explanation.
Croissant, grab her.
Hey, I got a stall to run here.
Fine. Good luck.
Game on, Texas.
The sausage is my treat then. When yer done with this li'l game, do remember to talk things out with her.
I'll think about it.
It actually started to rain.
Not a bad thing for someone trying to stay hidden.
Hm?
Huh? A venue change?
No way...
But it's raining over here. I can't make it over right now!
Find a way to make it happen?
Hey, aren't you being a bit too unreasonable here––
Hey!
What a jerk! Treating me like this just because I'm an up-and-comer...
Even if I hailed a cab, I wouldn't make it in time, and it's probably too late to call Texas... What should I do? Do I really have to throw in the towel?
You're Sora, right?
Oh, um, yes, yes I am....
Wait a sec, a blue-haired Sankta with horns... Are you Mostima, the one Exusiai's always looking for?
That's me.
I have to tell her...
Aren't you kind of busy?
Oh, I guess so.
I'm here to help.
Huh?
Don't worry, I'll go to her.
Really?
Really.
Then please, I'm counting on you! The address is––
You can tell me on the way. Hold onto my hand.
Oh, so you want to take the rooftops!
Here is good.
Right.
I can't believe I'm here ten minutes early.
Thank you so much, Mostima... Um, ma'am.
No need for the ma'am now.
But, why did you suddenly show up to help me?
Haven't you been hiding from Exusiai this whole time?
Uhh...
Wait, if you want to say something, you should be saying it to her, not me.
Right.
Oh say, this whole time, there's been something I've wanted to ask you. Do you mind?
If it's a question I can answer, fire away.
I want to know, are the Sankta... all as carefree as Exusiai?
Huh?
I guess, yeah, basically, most are.
Hmm... Okay.
I work as an idol. This might sound strange, but one of the most important parts of being an idol is figuring out how to read people's hearts.
I've always believed that if you can open your heart to anyone, then you probably have more than one door into your heart.
The people who seem nice to everyone must be hiding something deep inside.
But I don't think that's true for Exusiai.
Did you know, when Exusiai first joined Penguin Logistics, she was the absolute queen of troublemakers.
She would believe pretty much anything anyone told her.
I still remember that day, the day after she joined. The boss asked her to make a delivery so he could test her.
Texas had some things to do, so I ended up being her contact.
At first, I thought nothing would happen, but turns out...
Basically, you got scammed!
Huh? Is that what happened?
Of course! In this line of business, it's pretty common for goods to not match up with the sheet on the clipboard, but for there to only be one thing is virtually unheard of.
There must've been a mix-up.
Oh, I see.
I'm pretty sure what's going on here is they're spotting a newbie as a mark to take the fall and pushing the blame for the inevitable conflict onto Penguin Logistics.
You're pretty smart, huh, Sora?

Texas taught me that too...
No, no, now's not the time! We need to come up with something!
Is there a way out of this?

The simplest way is to find the gang leader who set you up and have him publicly come out to resolve the situation, but that would basically mean facing down the entire gang, so it's not like it's simple.
Then let's give it a try.
I just said, it's not that simple!
Texas, when did you...?
I heard a whisper on the wind, so I rushed over.
Are you alright?
Yes, but we're in kind of a pickle...
You said you'd give it a try, but do you think you have a shot?
No clue, but since I'm the one who messed up, I'll do what I can to set things right.
Come with me.
Alright.
So what was supposed to be a simple delivery task turned into the two of them rushing headlong into the territory of a small gang, grabbing their leader, and resolving the incident.
From that day on, Texas usually took Exusiai with her for all sorts of assignments.
Texas taught Exusiai a lot of the rules and laws of the biz, the do's and don'ts, so on and so forth.
And now, as you can see, they're good partners.
Does it feel like she snatched away your dear friend?
Maybe a little. But it's more like I'm filled with a sense of awe.
I just couldn't stop thinking to myself... Oh my gosh, how can a person like that be real?
This might sound funny, but I actually ended up spending a lot of time trying to figure out what she was hiding and expose her.
But the longer I searched, the clearer it became that Exusiai really is the same person on the inside that she is on the outside.
I'm not sure when it happened, but she became my friend too.
After talking to you today, I think the last little knot in my heart has been undone.
Oh, I need to hurry up and see the manager. If you have time later, I'll take you out for cake!
Sounds good.
How about you? Have you ever suspected her?
Nope.
I'm not the type to guess at people like that.
Whatever side people show me, I'll believe in it until they betray me.
That makes you pretty similar to El.
What are we gossiping about?
About whether or not you're a happy-go-lucky fool.
What's there to talk about? Do you think I'm not?
Look.
Haha, that's how she's always been, from the very beginning.
Oh.
Hold on a sec!
What is it?
I just realized we're right by the place I'm supposed to make a delivery to.
I almost forgot I was in the middle of a delivery when Texas called me over. I'll go take care of that real quick!
So, let's take a halftime break! Wait for me!
So, you're not gonna come at me?
No, because you're taking your game with her seriously.
The bar over there looks pretty decent. How about it?
Sure.
I've been thinking this whole time that you'd get along pretty well with a grumpy friend of mine.
And I've realized after meeting you, that you really are the type of person she'd aspire to be.
The what?
She's never said it before, but I know.
The feeling of pinning the past onto someone, or clinging to something in the past... For some unpleasant reason, I understand that all too well.
But you...
For the person she is now, you represent the past she was chasing after, one that will only disrupt her present life.
So you really were planning to kill me.
Sort of. I hope you die quietly in some ditch she doesn't know about.
Or become an afterimage that she can never catch up to.
El's made some real good friends.
Hey guys!
I have good news and bad news. Which do you wanna hear first?
The good news.
Another delivery has been completed!
I assume the bad news is you pissed off the recipient?
You got it!
Stupid Sankta, you're dead!
I wasn't done talking.
I changed my mind.
Oh?
If you were here just to play the good mentor, bending over to listen to the woes of your disciple because you happened to be in a good mood, I'd make you regret it.
But that doesn't seem to be the case.
I can tell you on that one, that's definitely not why I'm here.
Uhh, did I happen to walk in on a heavy conversation or something?
Should I go deal with them myself?
Nah, talk's over. I need some exercise anyway.
Gah, they're too strong.
L-Let's get outta here!
Oh... I'm getting a bit tired.
Want some chocolate?
Sure do. Mostima, want some...?
Huh? Where'd Mostima go?
Looks like she slipped away during the scuffle.
Aw, she Mostima'd...?
There's a letter here. Looks like it's for you.
For me? Huh, don't tell me she...
No, hold on, it's from my sister!

lines.st: El, I hope you are doing well.
I haven't written in a while. How are you?
Mostima should be handing this to you personally. If she has failed to do that, do be sure to tell me, and I will handle her appropriately.

lines.x: Oh, turns out Mostima came here to deliver this.
But I guess this counts as her having handed it to me, right?
Read the damned thing first.

lines.st: For the longest time, I've been thinking about how to tell you what happened, as your big sister.
Not just because it has to do with Lateran secrets, but more so because neither Mostima nor I feel about this event the way others do.
We're not upset by it, but if we have no way to tell you, then how are we to quell your anger and anxiety?
In the end, I chose to hide in Laterano and avoid you, and Mostima also chose to keep an appropriate distance from you.
All we can do is hope that you find new meaning in your life on the outside.
Don't blame Mostima. If anything, blame your cowardly sister who has been hiding this whole time.

lines.x: How could I ever blame you...?

lines.st: I once wished that this secret would never come to light. I wished that person would never reappear.
But now I've come to understand that was nothing but an unrealistic delusion.
I've already decided to join the Lateran Curia, and the reason I'm telling you this is––
If you still find yourself interested in the bygone past between me and Mostima, you might get an opportunity to explore it by helping me with my work.
Just to be forthcoming, even if you agree, it may take a long time for you to gain sufficient clearance.
And without a doubt, this will affect your life in Lungmen.
You've been in Lungmen for a long time, and I imagine you've already established a stable and fulfilling life. I don't want to get in the way of that.
Last time, I made a unilateral decision about your future, on my own whim. This time, you should make your own decision.
I hope that when you've carefully thought things through, you'll be able to give me your answer.
In the future, I'd like to make time to go see you in Lungmen. I'd like to have a nice chat with you.
Your sister who loves you dearly, Lemuen

lines.x: Your sister's a decent person.
Of course! She's the best!
Ohhh, your big sis's comin' to Lungmen?
Boss?! When'd you get here?
He's been standing there behind the counter bartending this entire time.
I popped in right the precise moment y'all walked into this bar.
This ain't the wrong joint, is it?
No, it's the right one. Look, it's them!
What are you two doing here?
Baws called us on over.
He dealt with that pesky manager, so I made my way over here.
Boss, does that mean...
Damn right. We got a day worth celebrating, so I decided we throwin' a partaaaay!
What are we celebrating?
